# OAL Live Guide Instructions

Preserve the source content and behavior in `index.html`. This folder is a visual application of the workspace-level `DESIGN-SYSTEM_1.md`, implemented as an override layer in `design-system.css`.

- Do not rewrite, remove, or reorder the guide's Microsoft 365 instructions unless explicitly requested.
- Preserve all ten numbered sections, source links, warnings, code commands, and footer disclaimers.
- Preserve live tenant, site, and library personalization, local persistence, theme switching, copy buttons, scrollspy, and progress state.
- Keep visual changes in `design-system.css` wherever possible so the imported source remains easy to compare.
- Use the shared warm instrument-panel tokens: hairline borders, compact spacing, mono data text, and restrained surfaces.
- Keep red semantic for alerts or critical emphasis and green semantic for success.
- Keep controls keyboard accessible and maintain visible focus states.
